description: Deterministic multi-user mock dataset for local/dev verification of the JodTod backend.

id_scheme.note: Every seeded row gets a stable UUID derived from its logical key, so re-running the seed updates the same rows (idempotent) and verification can address rows by key.

users.note: Local demo account. Password comes from JODTOD_DEMO_ADMIN_PASSWORD, not the shared seed password.

flat_rent.note: avery is owed 13000 from expenses, minus 5000 confirmed from rohan = 8000

food_mess.note: rohan's 300 rejected settlement does not change the balance

office_lunch.note: expense-only net for rohan is -500 (owes 800 meal, is owed 300 coffee); the 500 confirmed settlement (rohan -> arkadeep) zeroes it

login.per_user_override: A fixture user may set password_env to name its own env var (the arkadeep demo account uses JODTOD_DEMO_ADMIN_PASSWORD). Users without it share JODTOD_SEED_PASSWORD.
login.note: The seed refuses to run without the applicable password(s); no plaintext password is committed. Email containing 'admin' grants no privilege: there is no global user role, only per-group MemberRole.
